_limitations: Passthrough mode — Pure Data does not impose any OSC path layout. The bridge forwards under `/pd/...` to a [netreceive] object listening on UDP 9000 (configurable). You build the OSC parsing inside your patch via [oscparse] and route messages via [route]. Replies sent back via [netsend] / [oscformat] reach the bridge's reply_port and re-emit as `/pd/...` to clients.
